bio: Emma Pham-Tran First-Year Social Committee Ivy Yard Hello! My name is Emma Pham-Tran, and I’m a first-year from Sacramento, California. I currently live in Straus Hall, and plan to concentrate in Government, with a secondary in Global Health and Health Policy, as well as earn a language citation in Vietnamese. Some other organizations I’m a part of on campus include: a few of the Institute of Politics’ programs, the Harvard Undergraduate Law Review, Harvard Model United Nations, and the Vietnamese Student Association. When I do have free time, I love to read or get a treat in the square. I joined the FYSC to help create special moments for our class and foster an inclusive environment, so please feel free to reach out if you have any suggestions! You can always find me in a Cabot study room on weeknights, so feel free to say hi or stop and chat if you see me!
